summary: All Phase 1 hard requirements pass: monochrome token/type/component/painter/motif system builds clean, gallery builds for web, 5 tests green, Inter + IBM Plex Mono render, services and main.dart behavior preserved.

findings.detail: apps/user_app analyze reports 3 info-level avoid_print lints in lib/main.dart (lines 1320/1339/1341). These are pre-existing and sit in the file that must be preserved unchanged, so they are out of scope; shared_core analyze is fully clean (0 issues).
findings.fix: No action required for this task. If a future task is allowed to touch main.dart, replace the print() calls with a logging framework.

findings.detail: Gallery demo MRP text field default value is 'Rs.12O' (capital letter O) in packages/shared_core/lib/design_system/gallery/design_gallery.dart (~line 55), whereas the mock-data MRP is 'Rs.120' (zero). Cosmetic typo in a gallery sample field only; no component or token impact.
findings.fix: Change the TextEditingController default text from 'Rs.12O' to 'Rs.120' for consistency with the mock data.

findings.detail: packages/shared_core/lib/services/*.dart are line-for-line identical in content to the committed originals, but the working-tree copies use CRLF line endings (Windows checkout) vs the LF-stored blobs, so a raw byte compare differs. This is a repo-restructure/checkout artifact, not a change made by the design-system task; no code logic was altered.
findings.fix: No action required; preservation intent is met. If strict byte-identity is enforced, normalize line endings via .gitattributes rather than editing the files.
